gloss: to poke; to peck at; to pick at (food); to nitpick

definitions.gloss: to poke; to prod; to jab
definitions.explanation: To repeatedly push at something with a finger, stick, or pointed object.

definitions.gloss: to peck at; to pick at (food)
definitions.explanation: To eat in small amounts, poking at food without much appetite. Also used for birds pecking.

definitions.gloss: to nitpick; to find fault with
definitions.explanation: To criticize minor flaws or point out small problems.

examples.english: I poked the bug with a stick.

notes:
A colloquial godan verb that is an emphatic or repeated-action form of ⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧ (to poke). The っ gemination adds a sense of repeated, light action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{突|つ}っつく: to poke with a finger
- ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}っつく: to share a hot pot (picking at it together)
- ⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}っつく: to nitpick
- ⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}っつく: to touch on a sore spot

USAGE:
The hot-pot usage (⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{突|つ}っつく) is a common casual expression for sharing a communal dish, conveying a friendly, informal atmosphere.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧: to poke, to thrust — the base verb; more general and can indicate a single, stronger action
- ⟦つつく→つつく：10373_tsutsuku⟧: to peck, to poke — a softer variant without the geminate っ; essentially the same word
- ⟦{指摘|してき}する→指摘する：27890_shitekisuru⟧: to point out — formal equivalent of the nitpicking sense
